suggestions.title: Add owner notes per section
suggestions.reason: All sections exist, but owner-facing notes would make review easier.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add optional ownerNote fields for intro, variations, fill, and ending.

suggestions.title: Define density targets by section
suggestions.reason: Current drum density is global metadata; section-level density can guide future review.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add low/medium/high density intent for each section.

suggestions.title: Add bass movement contour
suggestions.reason: Bass movement is described broadly; contour tags can improve review precision.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add root_hold, passing_motion, and turnaround tags as metadata only.

suggestions.title: Add chord rhythm pattern labels
suggestions.reason: Chord rhythm exists as prose; labels help compare style sections.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add metadata labels such as stab, syncopated, held, and push.

suggestions.title: Separate feel from compatibility
suggestions.reason: Oriental feel should remain a musical reference, not a device claim.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Keep maqam/feel notes as reference-only metadata.

suggestions.title: Add melody space map
suggestions.reason: Live lead space is noted; section-level space improves arranger review.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add sparse/medium/busy melody-space values per section.

suggestions.title: Add DSP intent confidence
suggestions.reason: DSP channels are complete; confidence labels make future scoring clearer.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add low/medium/high confidence metadata for each DSP channel.

suggestions.title: Add reviewer checklist slots
suggestions.reason: Human review remains required; checklist slots can capture decisions safely.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Add empty metadata-only reviewer note fields.

suggestions.title: Keep export gates locked
suggestions.reason: All future suggestion consumers must preserve blocked output gates.
suggestions.suggestedMetadataChange: Mirror approvedForKorgExport, approvedForUsb, and approvedForKeyboardLoad as false.
